changeSet.comment: Remove any remaining unique constraints on order_number column. This is a follow-up to ensure all constraints are dropped.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE constraint_record RECORD; BEGIN -- Find and drop ALL unique constraints on order_number column FOR constraint_record IN SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'orders'::regclass AND contype = 'u' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = conrelid AND attname = 'order_number' AND attnum = ANY(conkey) ) LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS %I', constraint_record.conname); RAISE NOTICE 'Dropped unique constraint: %', constraint_record.conname; END LOOP; END $$;
ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uk_orders_order_number;
ALTER TABLE orders DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS uknthkiu7pgmnqnu86i2jyoe2v7;
